expected. Sea forecasts represent the average of the highest
one-third of the combined windwave and swell height.

.TONIGHT...E wind 25 kt becoming W. Seas 5 ft. Showers in the
evening, then rain late.
.WED...W wind 25 kt diminishing to 20 kt in the morning. Seas 4
ft. Rain in the morning.
.WED NIGHT...W wind 15 kt becoming S late. Seas 3 ft in the
evening then 2 ft or less.
.THU...NW wind 20 kt. Seas 4 ft.
.THU NIGHT...W wind 20 kt. Seas 4 ft.
.FRI...W wind 10 kt. Seas 2 ft or less.
.SAT...W wind 10 kt. Seas 2 ft or less.
.SUN...Light winds. Seas 2 ft or less.
